line: A felt-tip marker works out how far the horizon is from a beach, then shows that climbing a hundred times higher only lets you see ten times farther.
line_cn: 一支马克笔在白纸上算出海边能看多远，再告诉你：爬高 100 倍，只能多看远 10 倍。

camera.serves: a long arc; a row of algebra; a timeline being drawn

camera.serves: the red answer; a given being labelled; a final rule

the turn of an argument; a new case

transitions: Framing rules: a text is either wholly in frame or wholly out, never cut;
Transitions are only the push-through match cut and the peel.
No fades, no wipes, no slides, no page-flip graphics.
labels: Latin: Kalam (OFL) — Bold for questions, labels, answers; Regular for small notes. Chinese: LXGW Marker Gothic 霞鹜漫黑 (OFL), one short line under an English question.

Sizes at full frame: question 92–112 px; answer 100–120 px; labels 40–60 px; notes 30–40 px; Chinese on the sheet ≥ 34 px. Each glyph gets a fixed tiny tilt, baseline and size drift (±1.3°, ±1.7 %, ±2 %); no stroke, outline, shadow or double print.
Letters are written, not faded: questions ≈ 12 characters/s, labels 8–10/s. Written letters never boil.
Algebra is written in the drawing's colours, piece by piece (v = d ÷ t): the colour tells the viewer which line in the picture each term is.
motion: Drawings change on twos: 12 drawings a second at 24 fps. The camera moves smoothly at 24 fps.

Three boil drawings per sheet, built with the same seeds and differing only by a boil term (≤ 1 px along the normal), cycled on twos. Letters do not boil; random numbers are consumed independently of progress, so a half-written sheet and a finished one agree.
Speeds: a long arc is one sweep of 0.4–0.6 s; a hatch is a run of ~10 ms flicks; dashes are drawn one by one; an arrow is a shaft then two head strokes.
Black, then blue, then red. Structure first, the givens, then the unknown/answer. The red stroke lands on a beat and is held ≥ 1.5 s.

native_moves.name: The unknown in red
native_moves.does: Draw the situation in black, label the givens in blue, then one red arrow and d = ?.
native_moves.fits: how long a shadow is at noon; how much a loan costs in total; how fast a falling key hits the ground.

native_moves.name: Same colour, same quantity
native_moves.does: Carry each colour from the drawing into the equation, so algebra reads as a re-drawing.
native_moves.fits: splitting a bill with tip and tax; Ohm's law on a sketched circuit; area of a garden bed.

native_moves.name: Scribble it out
native_moves.does: A black back-and-forth scribble over a term or a wrong guess, with a small "tiny" or "no" note.
native_moves.fits: a negligible term; a myth corrected; an option ruled out.

native_moves.name: Push through a shape
native_moves.does: Push into a small drawn mark until it fills the frame; cut to a new sheet where the same mark sits at the same place, size and line weight; pull out.
native_moves.fits: a dot on a map becoming a city plan; a decimal point becoming a ruler; one cell becoming a table.

native_moves.name: Bars to scale, even when one is a dot
native_moves.does: Draw quantities as red strokes at true scale; the tiny one stays tiny.
native_moves.fits: a country's water use against agriculture; a lifetime against geological time; one person's emissions against a flight.

native_moves.name: The peel
native_moves.does: The corner lifts, a fold line sweeps from bottom-right to top-left, the sheet is pulled off, a fresh sheet below.
native_moves.fits: the next case; the second half of a proof; "now what if…".

native_moves.name: The last red circle
native_moves.does: The film's final stroke circles a rule or a number on the whole sheet.
native_moves.fits: the formula worth remembering; a deadline; the one figure to quote.
